implementation_summary: Root cause 1 (url-first beforeAll hang, all 6 skipped): fixed ports; when a port is already held, listen emits an error, its callback never runs and the hook waits out 30 s. Reproduced on runner-server (EADDRINUSE :3186 held by leftover vitest worker PID 20540, hook timeout, 9 skipped). Fix in both files: the fixture listens on an OS-picked port and rejects on a listen error, runner ports come from freePort(), restarts reuse the same port, afterAll guards an undefined runner and a closed fixture. Root cause 2 (runner-server 'scanning' vs 'awaiting-review'): poll-count waits gave the scan only 30-45 s and testing 150-350 s, too short on this 4-core laptop. Fix: deadline-based waits (scan 150 s, testing 400 s) that wait for awaiting-review/failed rather than any non-scanning phase (avoids a stale 'done' from the previous run), with elapsed time in the failure message. Test timeouts raised 240->600 s and 420->600 s, each with a comment giving the reason. No test deleted or skipped, no assertion weakened.

tests_proposed: Regression: RunnerServer with port 0 binds an OS-picked port (needs a product change first).
Move other browser tests that use fixed ports to OS-picked ports.
evidence: netstat during the failing run: [::]:3186 held by PID 20540 (tinypool worker, parent exited)

findings.title: RunnerServer treats port 0 as 3001 (`options.port || 3001`)
findings.recommendation: Use `options.port ?? 3001` and return the bound port from start(); auth-crawl-run.test.ts and test-cap-endpoints.test.ts pass port: 0 and likely bind 3001.

findings.title: A stopped run may keep executing tests after stop (not confirmed)
findings.recommendation: After a failed pause test, the stopped run's report was written during the next test, and the next run's status briefly read 'done'. Check that stop cancels testing immediately and that a late finish cannot overwrite a newer run's phase.

risks: Other browser test files still use fixed ports and can hang their hooks the same way.
The full --project browser run (EV-0006) also hit its 1800 s overall timeout; outside this task.
freePort() picks a port and frees it before the runner starts on it (small window).
handoff: Validation command passes 15/15 (929 s). Allow at least 1000 s for the check. The port-0 handling in server.ts and the stop behaviour need a product-owner look.
